WEB SOLUTION SYDNEY / WEBSITE PACKAGES

Website packages built around your business

A first website and a growing service business do not need exactly the same things. Start with the option closest to your needs, then get a written quote for the pages, content and features your project requires.

First Business Website

For businesses that need a professional place to explain their services and receive enquiries. A focused site can introduce your business, present your main offer and give customers an easy way to contact you.

The proposed scope includes a mobile-friendly design, core business copy, contact options and basic on-page SEO setup. Page count and any additional features are specified in your quote.

Service Business Website

For businesses with several services or more information to explain. Dedicated service pages make it easier for visitors to find the part of your business that matters to them.

The proposed scope includes service-page planning, relevant content, internal navigation, work examples where available and a quote enquiry form. Ongoing SEO can be added as a separate service.

Website Redesign

For businesses whose existing website looks dated, is difficult to use or no longer describes the business accurately. We review the existing pages before deciding what to retain, improve or replace.

Explore our website redesign service for more information about content, structure and the transition to a new website.

Know what you are paying for

Your proposal will distinguish the website build from recurring costs. Hosting, domain renewals, business email, maintenance, paid software and marketing should be clear before you commit. Features outside the agreed scope are quoted separately.

Common questions

How much will my website cost? The quote depends on the pages, content, features and any migration work. Tell us what you need and we will provide a project-specific price.

Do I need to write everything myself? We can help organise and write the content. You provide the business facts, service details and any project information that needs to be accurate.

Is SEO included? The proposed website build includes agreed SEO foundations such as page titles and a sensible content structure. Ongoing research, publishing and SEO work are separate.

Can the website grow later? We can plan the initial structure with future services in mind. Additional pages and features can then be scoped when you need them.

Comparing affordable website design packages

An affordable project starts with a useful scope. Separate what your first website needs from features that can wait: explain your services, make contact simple and give visitors evidence they can trust. A fixed page count is only one part of a quote; writing, image sourcing, revisions and launch support also affect the work involved.

Our website costs guide sets out the items to compare. Ask for one-off and recurring costs separately, including website hosting and maintenance. We provide a written project quote rather than advertising a price that leaves essential work unclear.
